item.title: Death toll from heavy snow in Japan hits 30
item.description: Heavy snowfall across northern Japan has killed at least 30 people in two weeks, prompting troop deployments and urgent warnings as deep accumulations threaten roof collapses and falling snow.

item.title: China moves to kill hidden 'flush' door handles in sweeping car safety crackdown
item.description: Beijing targets a Tesla-popular design after high-profile rescue failures, mandating mechanical handles on new vehicles.

item.title: US judge blocks Trump's plan to end protections for 350,000 Haitians
item.description: Haiti’s TPS designation was first established in 2010 following a devastating earthquake and has been renewed several times.

item.title: New US bill targets constitutional abuses by ICE agents
item.description: 'President Trump’s immigration enforcers are violating our Constitutional rights,' says Rep. Andrea Salinas.

item.title: Trump seeks $1 billion in damages from Harvard University
item.description: The US government targets Harvard following settlements with Columbia and the University of Pennsylvania.

item.title: Drone crashes inside Polish military base near arms depot
item.description: An unidentified UAV’s crash inside a secure compound sharpens NATO countries' fears over surveillance and base security.

item.title: China remains the world's top shipbuilder in 2025
item.description: The country's shipbuilding output reaches 53.69 million deadweight tonnes, accounting for 56 percent of global output.

item.title: Syrian security forces enter into Qamishli under deal with YPG
item.description: Internal security forces enter Hasakah province amid warm welcome from local residents

item.title: German chancellor calls for 'more independent' Europe amid global upheavals
item.description: 'We must get things under control now if we want to play a role in this global transformation phase,' Friedrich Merz warns.

item.title: Indian exporters welcome US-India trade deal as analysts urge caution
item.description: US President Trump announces "trade deal" with India, saying PM Narendra Modi promised to stop buying Russian energy and may purchase it instead from Venezuela.
